cast_direction: Mix politicians and celebrities, as requested. Four riders built; eight proposed.
field_size_note: There is no universal horse-racing maximum. Twelve is the prototype target; Breeders' Cup races use 12 or 14, and the Kentucky Derby uses 20.

riders.name: Donald Trump
riders.gag: Red hat throw; actual recorded 'You're fired!'

riders.name: Joe Biden
riders.gag: Ducks the hat and answers with the actual 'C'mon, man!' clip.

riders.name: Mitch McConnell
riders.gag: Blank car-meme stare, completely unmoved by the chaos.

riders.name: Bernie Sanders
riders.gag: Parka, crossed arms and actual mittens photo; refuses to hold the reins.

riders.name: Snoop Dogg
riders.gag: Immaculate riding outfit, relaxed face, horse doing a ridiculous dressage step.

riders.name: Elon Musk
riders.gag: Overexcited bouncing in the saddle while his horse stays dead serious.

riders.name: Gordon Ramsay
riders.gag: Leans forward to shout at his own horse instead of the other riders.

riders.name: Nicolas Cage
riders.gag: An enormous wide-eyed reaction face whenever another rider passes.

riders.name: Danny DeVito
riders.gag: A tiny stiff torso low in the saddle, with the same oversized photo-head treatment.

riders.name: Mike Tyson
riders.gag: Gloves up, shadowboxing at the air while the horse calmly carries him.

riders.name: Kamala Harris
riders.gag: A laughing reaction to the hat chaos, timed to a real recording if sourced.

riders.name: Boris Johnson
riders.gag: Dishevelled hair and baffled expression, looking as if he got on the wrong ride.
